meta.title: CPA Switch
meta.description: Manage CPA (CLIProxyAPI) accounts from Settings: balances, one-click check-in, tasks, account switching, and automatic start/stop with DSH.

en.autoCheckinHint: CPA checks in every account daily at 09:00 and 21:00
en.consoleHint: CPA's own console (advanced settings and account imports live there)
en.creditsPartlyUnreadableHint: The totals above exclude them; click "{action}" to retry
en.creditsUnreadableHint: Click "{action}" in the toolbar to retry; if it keeps happening, check the account status for this channel in CPA
en.cycleHint: Cycle end dates come from the provider; unused quota may not expire then
en.cycleUpcoming: {count} quota package cycles end within {days} days
en.disableHint: A disabled account never takes requests
en.emptyNoAccountsHint: Click "{action}" below and finish signing in your browser
en.enableHint: It only takes requests while enabled
en.foreignNotice: That instance was not started by this plugin
en.foreignNoticeHint: The plugin cannot stop it and does not have its admin key, so the account list below may come back empty. To use it, point exePath at it in settings and fill in its admin key; to use the plugin’s own copy, stop it first.
en.issueConfigLoad: CPA refused to start: bad config
en.issueConfigLoadHint: It failed to load its config. Delete config.yaml in the managed directory, then run Set up again to regenerate it.
en.issuePortInUse: CPA could not start: port already in use
en.issuePortInUseHint: Something else is already listening on 127.0.0.1:{port}, so CPA cannot bind it.
en.issueVersionRejected: CPA refused to start: config generation mismatch
en.issueVersionRejectedHint: This CPA expects config generation v{expected}, but the plugin generates v{actual}. They differ, so CPA refuses to start.
en.issueVersionRejectedHintBare: This CPA and the config the plugin generates are of different generations, so CPA refuses to start.
en.loginHint: Opened the authorization page. If it did not open, use this link:
en.loginIntro: Signing in opens the provider page. Finish there — no link copying needed.
en.loginWaiting: Waiting for authorization… the list refreshes by itself
en.modelsEmpty: This channel has no models yet (add an account in CPA first).
en.modelsHint: This only decides **which models appear in the chat model picker**. Unchecked models still work through the API — they are just hidden from the dropdown. Takes effect after you click Save.
en.panelCrashed: The {panel} section could not be displayed
en.pluginUpdateCurrent: Channel plugins {tag} are up to date
en.pluginUpdateDoneStopped: Channel plugins updated to {tag}. CPA is stopped — start it again when you need it
en.pluginUpdateRunFailed: Update failed; the previous version was restored
en.pluginUpdateUnknown: Installed version unknown (not recorded) · upstream has {latest}
en.selectHint: Use only this account and disable the rest of the channel
en.setupIntro: This plugin does not bundle CPA or the channel plugins. The button below downloads, verifies and extracts them — about 40 MB.
en.setupNote: An existing CPA install is never overwritten. To use one, point exePath at it in settings.
en.setupVersionMismatch: Config generation mismatch: this CPA expects v{expected} but the config being loaded is v{actual}, so it will refuse to start.
en.sidebarEntryHint: When off, the panel is only reachable from the Plugins page
en.strategyWarn: With several accounts enabled in one channel, every request switches accounts. The upstream cache almost never hits, so you spend noticeably more quota.
